defensiveAbilities.name: Cold Adaptation
defensiveAbilities.description: The lagofir reduces the effects it suffers from cold environments by one step.

defensiveAbilities.name: Consuming Fumes
defensiveAbilities.description: 15 feet. The lagofir is surrounded by fumes from the flammable oil it exudes. Each nonmagical open flame the size of a torch or larger within the emanation explodes, dealing 4d4 Fire Damage damage to all creatures and objects adjacent to the flame (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw). After exploding, the fire source is extinguished.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deep Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: A lagofir can hold its breath for 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flammable
offensiveAbilities.description: Lagofirs excrete a warm, flammable oil. Any creature that Grapples a lagofir or is Grabbed or Restrained by a lagofir becomes coated in lagofir oil for 10 minutes or until the oil is washed off, which takes 1 minute of vigorous scrubbing. Any time a lagofir or a creature coated in lagofir oil is dealt fire damage, it catches flame, taking 1d6 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gnaw
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The lagofir's last action was a successful jaws Strike

Effect The lagofir gnaws on the target, driving its teeth deeper into its prey. The target takes (1d8+3) Piercing Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Rush
offensiveAbilities.description: The lagofir attacks while darting around its foes. The lagofir Strides twice and Strikes at any point during its movement. It can substitute a Swim action in place of any Stride.
